meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求变成一份可直接动工的实施方案,动手前理清步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手写代码前,想先拿出一份清晰的实施计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough request into one decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan nailed down before writing any code.

howto.what: Claude 会切换到 Ultrawork Planner 规划顾问模式:先打出「ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!」,做只读探索,并在 .omo/ 下写出一份决策完整的计划。它不会改产品代码,你的同意也只授权写计划。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求走 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求在做实现前先出计划时触发;单独一次 ulw 运行不会自动激活它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 把这个需求做成一份可执行的计划
say.note: 它会先只读探索,再逐步给出方案

say.text: 动手前先用 ulw-plan 规划一下
say.note: 它只写计划,不改代码,执行要另行启动

say.text: 高精度规划:给 /login 做每 IP 限流
say.note: 会标记 review_required 并走高精度评审

howto.what_en: Claude switches to the Ultrawork Planner mode: it announces ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!, explores read-only, and writes one decision-complete plan under .omo/. It never edits product code, and your okay only authorizes writing the plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to turn this request into an executable plan
say_en.note: It explores read-only first, then drafts the plan

say_en.text: Plan this with ulw-plan before touching any code
say_en.note: It writes plans only and never edits code

say_en.text: High-accuracy planning: per-IP rate limiting for /login
